title: (No AI) Apple’s latest watchOS beta includes its new always-on Audio Intelligence features
author: Stevie Bonifield
content:
![Simulated iphone and apple watch screenshots for Siri Recap](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/Siri-Recap-example.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Starting today, Siri can tune into the Apple Watch's mic with [Audio Intelligence features](https://www.theverge.com/tech/991812/apple-watch-series-12-announcement) that are available in the new watchOS 27.3 developer beta rolling out now. The two new additions are Siri Recap, which uses "ambient listening" to generate summaries of your conversation, and Live Rewind, which generates text transcripts of the last 15 seconds of audio your watch's mic detected.

**[Apple](https://support.apple.com/en-us/148354)**:

title: (No AI) OpenAI says ChatGPT is catching up to Google in search
author: Hayden Field
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/STK155_OPEN_AI_CVirginia_C-1.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

In many circles, "Ask Chat" has replaced "Google it," and that's reflected in a new announcement from OpenAI: the volume of search queries run through ChatGPT now equals 20 percent of the volume run through Google.

Adam Fry, OpenAI's consumer product lead for ChatGPT, made the announcement at a press event on Monday. He said the company defines a search as any time a user inputs a query that results in a web search, as opposed to tasks like defining a term or a simple how-to explanation. (Fry did not specify the source of the Google search volume number.)

Having one-fifth as many searches as Google is still a long way from overtaking it, b …
